zh: 盐点港的海面之下，潮门背后，藏着一个海中王国。
en: Beneath Saltpoint Coast, behind the Tidal Gate, lies a kingdom of the sea.

zh: 按最古老的律法，王子必须先娶新娘，才能加冕。
en: By its oldest law, the prince cannot be crowned until he takes a bride.

zh: 议会已经替他选好了人。
en: The council has already chosen one for him.

zh: 而潮门发光时，找到它的人类……会被留下，并忘记一切。
en: And when the gate glows, any human who finds it is kept... and made to forget.
Skye, look! The water is glowing!

zh: 潮门 · 藏在海下的王宫
en: The Tidal Gate · a palace beneath the sea

zh: 我朋友，穿黄外套的。她在哪？
en: My friend. Yellow jacket. Where is she?

zh: 她很安全。访客不得进入这一翼。未登记的访客会被扣留，
en: She is safe. Visitors cannot enter this wing. Unregistered visitors are held,

zh: 关于这里的记忆，也会被封存。
en: and their memory of this place is sealed.
